title: Ontology normalization (HGNC/MONDO/Cellosaurus/ChEBI) + fusion vocab
context: Extracted entities must map to pinned ontologies so downstream consumers get stable identifiers. Binding cancer guardrails apply: open-access (PMC OA Subset) / aggregate / de-identified data only; no identifiable patient data; no medical advice; provenance on every assertion. Ontology versions are recorded and bumped only via a deliberate task; unmapped entities are flagged rather than guessed.
objective: Normalize extracted entities to pinned ontologies (HGNC/MONDO/Cellosaurus/ChEBI) with a controlled fusion vocabulary.
acceptanceCriteria: Maps entities to pinned ontologies (HGNC, MONDO/NCIt, Cellosaurus, ChEBI) recording ontologyId + ontologyVersion + normConfidence; fusion types mapped via the in-repo controlled vocabulary to HGNC ids; unmapped entities flagged unmapped (kept as surface forms).
Spot-check examples documented (e.g. Ewing sarcoma -> MONDO:0012817; A673 -> CVCL_0080).
Ontology versions recorded in specVersions; bumped only via a deliberate task.
